Anthropic announces Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5

By Anthropic Team — July 14, 2026

Anthropic today announced two new models in its Mythos tier: Claude Mythos 5 and Claude Fable 5. Both models share the same underlying architecture, but Fable 5 includes additional safety measures for biology, cybersecurity, and LLM research and development.

The models first became available on June 9, 2026. Access was briefly suspended on June 12 to comply with U.S. Department of Commerce export controls, before being restored on July 1, 2026 after the controls were lifted.

Early users have reported strong performance on coding and long-context tasks, though some have noted that the suspension created uncertainty about long-term availability of the models for teams building on top of them.

Anthropic said pricing for both models remains unchanged from the previous generation, and that existing API integrations continue to work without changes.
